TC-10/S23.title: Visual lane: axe, phone widths and WebKit on the Pre-Round tab, the open editor (both modes), the summary-failed message, the disabled-Generate reason
TC-10/S23.detail: Re-run on 43c38a4f: the visual lane's own test (web/qa-agent-tests/visual/preround.spec.ts 'TC-10/S23 …', seeded charts, no Save Note, every action refused by its firewall) with its outputs redirected into newspec-c, under the local lock; desktop Chrome, Pixel 7 (Chromium) and iPhone 15 (WebKit). 135 judged checks pass, 39 fail — the same split as on e02167f. Passing: the editor fills the viewport in both modes (AC 11), the dictation box is the larger box (Q8 ratio recorded: Hospital 1.85–1.89, Nursing Home 2.63–3.39), Save Note, the error and the disabled-Generate reason stay visible, nothing overflows or is covered/truncated, Generate is disabled on the failed charts and its reason is a role=alert in both modes. Failing: axe serious/critical on every state (colour contrast of the uppercase section labels and grey stamps; the Nursing Home back button has no name — critical); the Nursing Home editor is not a dialog and has no name (its boxes are named only by their placeholders); the Hospital summary error ('The reviewed note is saved, but its structured summary needs another attempt…') is in no live region, on the tab or in the editor. Known: A2 (errors not announced) with A1 / A4 (unnamed controls, contrast) — our own accessibility checks, suggestions under Quinn's rule. iOS keyboard behaviour: manual (device).
